concerns.analysis: The HTML output contains multiple overlapping crops of the same infographic from the bottom of Page 1, resulting in partial image duplication. The HTML features three consecutive `<figure>` elements where one image shows the full set of four icons, another image captures the icons alongside the blue sidebar content, and a third image shows a zoomed-in crop of just the calendar and target icons. This presents the same visual information to the user multiple times.
